ntfx.title: Notification texts
ntfx.description: The words of each notification, in English and Urdu, in the application and by e-mail, and who is told besides the people an event names. A text uses names in braces such as '{employee_name}'; the list beside the text shows what each event offers. The product's own wording can always be restored.
ntfx.denied: You may not see the notification texts.
ntfx.loadError: The notification texts could not be loaded.
ntfx.empty.body: No module has declared an event to notify on yet.
ntfx.list.title: Notifications
ntfx.pick.body: Open a notification to see and change its texts and who is told.
ntfx.versions: {count, plural, one {# version kept.} other {# versions kept.}}
ntfx.none: There is no text in this language and channel yet. Write one and save it.
ntfx.subject: Subject
ntfx.placeholders: Names you can use (press one to add it to the text)
ntfx.sample: Sample values for the preview (optional; empty ones are filled in for you)
ntfx.unsaved: You have changes that are not saved.
ntfx.preview.title: Preview
ntfx.preview.note: A preview uses sample values; nothing is sent.
ntfx.test.sent: A test e-mail is on its way to you.
ntfx.restore.title: Restore the product text?
ntfx.restore.effect: The product's own wording becomes the active text again for this language and channel. Your text stays in the history.
ntfx.restored: The product text is active again.
ntfx.rules.intro: A rule adds people to the audience of this notification: everyone with a role, and named people. The people the event itself names are always told.
ntfx.rules.none.body: Only the people the event names are told.
ntfx.rule.who: {people, plural, =0 {Roles: {roles}.} one {Roles: {roles}. 1 named person.} other {Roles: {roles}. # named people.}}
ntfx.rule.edit.title: Change the rule
ntfx.rule.delete.title: Delete this rule?
ntfx.rule.delete.effect: The people it adds are no longer told because of this rule.
ntfx.rule.name: Name
ntfx.rule.person.unknown: A person (name not available to you)
ntfx.rule.nobody: Choose at least one role or person.
